title: Government background check on Harrington's neighbours

tellings.quote: because about a year earlier or so, we had been approached, the family, by some like NSA or like CIA or someone that come in and asked a bunch of questions.

plain: Brent Friedman, who grew up in Walnut Creek, California, says that around 1980 his family was questioned by people from a government spy agency, "like NSA or like CIA", about a year before something to do with their neighbour John S. Herrington, a government official. Friedman tells it as a memory from his own family, read as a background check on the official's neighbours.
